messages:
Aisha (CSM): Hey team — Navarro Health asked for a hands-on 'emulator lab' to validate Dedicated migration + network setup before their pilot. They prefer a midday APAC-friendly window next week (Mon/Tue), roughly 02:00-05:00 PDT.

Aisha (CSM): Draft agenda:```
- 10m intros + goals
- 20m infra walkthrough (customer topology + VPC peering)
- 40m guided emulator run (we spin up a test job)
- 20m troubleshooting & perf tweaks
- 10m next steps / migration checklist
```

Aisha (CSM): Needs: facilitator, demo owner, note-taker, calendar invite, and preread doc. Can someone own facilitation? :pray:

Mika (Enablement): I can facilitate the lab on Tue if that helps — prefer 02:30 PDT. I can run the walkthrough and lead the emulator run. :raised_hands:

Tom (Solutions Eng): I can take demo infra + checklist. Will prepare a tiny preread with network requirements and a sample terraform snippet.

Priya (CS Ops): I’ll handle the calendar booking and attendee list. @Aisha can you confirm expected attendees and whether they need service account access or just SSH jumpbox?

Aisha (CSM): Expecting: 6 Navarro engineers (infra + app) + 2 product owners. They requested not to share keys — prefer temporary IAM role & scoped service account.

Tom (Solutions Eng): Noted. I'll include the scoped role steps in preread and a quick command for temporary creds: ```
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/navarro-temp --role-session-name emulator-lab
```

Samir (Scheduler Bot): Available windows (converted to PDT): Mon 02:00-03:30, Mon 03:00-04:30, Tue 02:30-04:30.

Priya (CS Ops): Locking Tue 02:30-04:00 PDT for now. Draft invite created — please review attendees & agenda. calendar-bot: https://calendar.redwood.com/event/abcdef123456

Mika (Enablement): Great — I'll prep a short checklist for the run (model binary, quantization profile, batch sizes). Will post by EOD today. :memo:

Tom (Solutions Eng): I'll upload the preread doc to the invite and add a short runbook snippet. Also will include a fallback plan if they can't reach the VPC (replicate locally with port-forward).

Aisha (CSM): Awesome — Priya, please set RSVP cutoff 24h before. Add note to invite: 'Please confirm if a read-only observer or active engineer will join'.

Priya (CS Ops): Done — RSVP cutoff set. Also adding Zoom + JIT VPN steps in the description.

Mika (Enablement): Quick ask — can someone run a permissions sanity check with Navarro's infra lead before the session? 15m call works.

Aisha (CSM): Yes, I'll schedule a 15m preflight with their infra lead tomorrow. 

Tom (Solutions Eng): :thumbsup: I'll be on the preflight to validate roles and demo access.

Aisha (CSM): Great. Thanks everyone — will post final preread link after Tom uploads. :sparkles:
